_comment: Gate 0 pre-registration precondition 3 (reports/2026-07-18-gate0-prereg.md) -- frozen expected pins for arm 'miniwob', independent of any observed run receipt. Consumed by tools/check_gate0_codex.py::audit()'s expected_pins argument (schema_version 2, all tools.check_gate0_codex.PIN_FIELDS present) and, indirectly, by eval/score_gate0.py's SOURCE_PIN_FILES['readiness_dev'|'paid_gate0'].audit_paths.miniwob.expected_pins (hash-pinned there). See eval/fixtures/gate0_expected_pins.SOURCES.md for the full source-citation table (INDEPENDENCE LAW: no value here was copied from runs/gate0_readiness_2026-07-14/miniwob-v2/handshake-receipt.json or any other observed receipt).
_source_readiness: code-mandated constant: tools/check_gate0_codex.py:46 requires this exact string on every receipt; tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:380 (`readiness = 'NO_GO_INSUFFICIENT_WAKES'`) and its pinned test tests/test_run_gate0_codex_launcher.py::test_launcher_is_free_handshake_only_and_fail_closed both hold the launcher to producing only this value until a separate paid launcher with real wake accounting exists.
_source_paid_execution_enabled: code-mandated constant: tools/check_gate0_codex.py:48 and tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:381 (`paid_execution_enabled = $false`); the launcher contains no `codex exec` path (design doc reports/2026-07-13-minimum-north-star-gate-0-design.md:242-243).
_source_auth_method: code-mandated constant: tools/check_gate0_codex.py:50 and tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:382; ChatGPT-subscription-only is constitutive of Gate 0 (pre-reg 'Fixed Codex brain, pool = ChatGPT/Codex subscription only').
_source_planned_model: design-level plan, not a receipt value: HANDOFF.md:53 ('...planned model `gpt-5.4` now produces safe free receipts for both arms'), no `latest` alias per design doc:96-98 and tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:145-147. NOT copied from runs/gate0_readiness_2026-07-14/*/handshake-receipt.json -- those are cited only as confirmation this plan was already exercised, per the pre-reg's own instruction that this field 'must be re-observed and hashed fresh at signature, not copy-pasted' (reports/2026-07-18-gate0-prereg.md:40-41). Must match the red pin exactly (CONSTANCY_FIELDS) -- it does.
_source_codex_version: freshly, independently observed 2026-07-19 by running `codex --version` on the launch machine (same command as tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:162), NOT read from any receipt file. Matches the codex_version already narrated in HANDOFF.md:53 as the currently-installed CLI, confirming no drift since that free handshake -- this is corroboration of an independent observation, not the source of it.
_source_codex_path: freshly, independently resolved 2026-07-19 via `Get-Command codex -CommandType Application -All` filtered to the sole `.exe` candidate, exactly reproducing tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:36-44,159-165's Resolve-CodexExecutable contract (exactly one `.exe` candidate found). Machine-specific by construction -- if Gate 0 launches from a different machine or a moved install, this pin correctly fails closed until re-frozen.
_source_codex_executable_sha256: freshly computed 2026-07-19: SHA-256 of the exact codex.exe resolved above (Get-FileSha256, same routine as tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:32-34,386), NOT copied from any receipt's codex_executable_sha256 field.
_source_critical_config_transport: code-mandated constant: tools/check_gate0_codex.py:52 and tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:307-318,387 (the $Overrides array is the effective config, not fresh-project trust).
_source_mcp_tools_observed: code-mandated constant list, exact order: tools/check_gate0_codex.py:13-14 (TOOLS['miniwob']), cross-checked against tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:200-201 ($Tools for the miniwob branch) -- both sources agree.
_source_brain_config_sha256: computed 2026-07-19 by AST-extracting and evaluating tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1's own $BrainConfigText assignment (lines 269-291) with Model='gpt-5.4' bound as the launcher would bind it, then SHA-256 of the UTF-8-no-BOM bytes (Write-Utf8NoBom contract, lines 22-24) -- the exact deterministic content the real launcher produces, extracted via the same AST-parse technique tests/test_run_gate0_codex_launcher.py already uses (RESOLVER_HARNESS et al.), not hand-transcribed (the here-string is CRLF-internal, LF-terminal; hand transcription would risk a wrong hash). Identical for both arms by construction ($BrainConfigText does not depend on $Arm) -- this is also a CONSTANCY_FIELDS field, so it must match the red pin exactly; it does.
_source_task_sha256: computed 2026-07-19 the same AST-extraction way as brain_config_sha256, from tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:202,259-262's miniwob $TaskSentence + $CommonTask + a trailing LF (Write-Utf8NoBom contract). The brief text matches the design intent for Arm W (reports/2026-07-18-gate0-prereg.md 'Arms' table: task instruction comes from the environment itself; the brief only states the five-episode/screen-pixels/mouse-and-keyboard constraint) and names no specific seed.
_source_config_sha256: CANNOT be independently pre-computed: config.toml's mcp_servers.gate0_world.args embeds the resolved Docker $ImageId as a literal docker-run argument (tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:244-256,266,296), and world_image_id itself is not yet frozen (see world_image_id below, precondition 9). This is a genuine, not a lazy, CONSTRAINT: the field's true value is a function of an image digest that does not exist yet. Refuses to match any receipt until updated -- fail-closed, not loosened.
_source_codex_mcp_list_sha256: Same dependency as config_sha256: `codex mcp list --json` is invoked with the same $Overrides array that embeds $ImageId (tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:308-327), so its output -- and hash -- shifts with the image digest. CONSTRAINT for the same reason, not independently computable pre-rebuild.
_source_tool_schema_sha256: Requires a live tools/list handshake against the actual pinned world image (tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:346-375). The locally-built miniwob-world image predates PR #114's canonical-hash fix (precondition 9, reports/2026-07-18-gate0-prereg.md row 9, NOT MET) -- deliberately not exercised against a known-stale image to avoid freezing a value from an image that will be rebuilt and discarded.
_source_world_image_tag: code-mandated constant per arm: tools/check_gate0_codex.py:70 (`expected_tag = 'gb-mcp-world' if arm == 'red' else 'miniwob-world'`) and tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:203 ($ImageTag).
_source_world_image_id: Docker image content digests are build-process-dependent, not a pure function of tracked source -- cannot be independently precomputed at all. Precondition 9 (reports/2026-07-18-gate0-prereg.md row 9) requires 'World images rebuilt from a clean checkout AFTER #114 merges'; that rebuild is a parallel, still-open PR. The locally-built images observed 2026-07-19 (gb-mcp-world sha256:8701e664..., miniwob-world sha256:7128be60...) are the SAME stale pre-fix images cited in reports/2026-07-14-gate0-readiness.md's C0 receipts -- explicitly not promoted here, per the INDEPENDENCE LAW's ban on copying receipt values and per precondition 9's own instruction not to invent a digest. Update this pin from the image-rebuild report once it lands.
_source_host_code_sha256: computed 2026-07-19 directly via `git cat-file blob HEAD:world_mcp.py` / `HEAD:core/miniwob_world.py` at commit b45b47f (this branch's base), matching the canonical-git-blob contract of world_mcp.py::code_sha256() and tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:128-134's Get-CanonicalCodeSha256 -- computed directly from the repo, not from any receipt. Re-freeze if either file changes before the actual Gate 0 launch commit.
_source_image_code_sha256: Pinned equal to host_code_sha256 above: this IS the parity requirement (tools/run_gate0_codex.ps1:215-242, 'stale_world_image' check in tools/check_gate0_codex.py:82-85) -- once precondition 9's rebuild lands from this same commit's clean checkout, the image's in-container code must hash to exactly these values or the receipt is CONSTANCY_BREACH by construction. Not copied from any receipt; it is the target the rebuild is required to hit.
